control_design.primary: 360 non-overlapping two-hour windows: 12 UTC-aligned windows on each of 30 pre-event days
control_design.matched_clock_sensitivity: 30 windows at 20:30-22:30 UTC on each pre-event day
control_design.serial_dependence_caveat: The rank/randomization p-values require exchangeability and are descriptive because adjacent crypto-market windows may be serially dependent.

robustness.interpretation: Confirmed public-label addresses are primary; unconfirmed behavioral candidates are sensitivity-only, and the large-flow watchlist is excluded from both exchange-flow definitions.

lead_lag.lag_convention: positive lag means x leads y
lead_lag.full_sample: 2025-09-10 through 2025-10-10 UTC (30 pre-event days plus event day)
lead_lag.transformations: Nonnegative activity/flow variables use log1p; signed nets use asinh scaled by the median nonzero absolute value; full-sample variables are de-seasoned by UTC minute/5-minute slot median.
lead_lag.significance: Circular-shift max-|correlation| test across all reported lags, deterministic seed 20251010.

order_book_limitation.permitted_claim: The executed-trade and cross-venue pattern is consistent with a pair-specific liquidity or market-microstructure disruption.
order_book_limitation.reason: Without historical depth snapshots, the study cannot reconstruct resting depth, cancellations, queue age, or the state of the Binance ATOM/USDT book immediately before the print.
